00_acilis: When you open Netice, a short opening animation welcomes you.
01_tanitim: On first launch you see a few pages introducing the app. Tap Continue to move on.
02_ana: The home screen shows a summary of your exams. Tap the plus button at the top right for a new exam, or Scan to read answer sheets. You can remove the sample data with Delete samples.
03_siniflar: Switch to Classes in the bottom menu. Import your students from an Excel list, or add them one by one with Add student.
04_yeni_sinav: On the new exam screen, set the number of questions with the plus and minus buttons or by typing it, choose the number of options, enter the answer key and tap Save exam.
05_form_yazdir: On the exam screen, choose Print forms from the menu at the top right and hand out the answer sheets.
06_okut: When the exam is over, tap the Scan button.
07_okut_ekrani: Scan the sheets with the camera or pick their photos from the gallery. Netice reads each sheet in seconds.
08_sonuclar: The Results tab shows each student's correct, wrong and blank answers and their score.
09_analiz: From the Analysis tab you can get the exam report and student report cards as PDF.
10_ogrenci: The student page shows progress and warns you about students whose results are dropping.
11_kurum: On the Profile tab, open Institution details and choose your institution type. Enter the parent body, the units and your institution's name, and pick titles and ranks from the lists. Your reports then carry an official header and a signature area.
12_kutuphane: Build your own question bank in the Library. Sort questions into easy, medium and hard, and keep your lesson notes and quick tips here too.
12_ayarlar: In Settings you can change the app language, turn off the opening melody and back up your data.
13_yardim: If you get stuck, tap the question mark on the home screen; the guide, videos and FAQ are there. Enjoy!
